[u][b][h3]Service Dog Demo is now Live![/h3][/b][/u]

Explore the full town of Woofton, a giant sandbox level packed with chaos, charm, and canine mayhem.

🚩 What's in the Demo:

🐕 1 fully unlocked, handcrafted level: Woofton

🧩 9 Quests + 12 Side Goals to discover

🗣️ Several fully voiced NPCs

🎵 A completely original soundtrack

🤪 Plenty of secrets, surprises, and silliness

This is just a taste of what’s to come—and yes, you can pee on things.

Download the demo, cause trouble, and let us know what you think!
